description: This file is a shell script (`.sh`) that contains test cases for Git bundle functionalities, including creating, verifying, and fetching from bundles, as well as testing various edge cases and configurations within the Git project.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a command or series of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail, asserting failure.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in the output or a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific path does not exist.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup actions to run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Runs a command in a non-Git directory context.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Provides object identifiers or related info used in tests.
